caption: The drawing depicts a single object, which is a mold in the shape of a fish. The mold is represented lying flat and oriented horizontally with the fish’s head on the right and the tail on the left. The mold appears to be made of a dark brown material with variations in shading to indicate depth and contours. The fish shape is detailed with carved scales along the body, a visible gill, a rounded eye, a small fin below the gill, and fin shapes at the sides and tail. The edges of the mold are slightly raised, creating a clear boundary around the fish shape. The background is plain and light beige, with a simple rectangular border surrounding the drawing of the mold. There are small, faint handwritten notations in the bottom right corner of the border area.
title: Fish Mold
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
